for B in range(1,21):
  row=[]
  for A in range(1,B+1):
    FULL=(1<<B)-1; W=sum(1<<i for i in range(A-1,B))
    maxcyc=0; allseen=set()
    # sample masks and singleton, random
    masks=[1<<i for i in range(B)] + [FULL] + [0]

      seen={}; x=m; t=0
      while x not in seen:
        seen[x]=t; t+=1
        nb=1 if x&W else 0
        x=((x<<1)|nb)&FULL
      maxcyc=max(maxcyc,t-seen[x])
    row.append(maxcyc)
  print(B,row)
